Awful food, we left hungry.
Sep 2025 • Couples
Ordered the duck with orange sauce. We got a reheated piece of smoked duck smothered in an orange flavoured mayonnaise. It was horrible and nothing like the picture on the menu or the same dish we ate in April2024. See my review titled “Two main courses were sufficient for 2 adults” and compare the photos attached to this review. We also ate some noodles with stir fried vegetables. That consisted of a Maggi style instant noodle and a few vegetables. I should have listened to the recent poor reviews that highlighted preferential treatment given to large tour groups. There was a large group leaving as we arrived, and I asked a woman about the food. Her answer was “it is good BUT we have a regular booking’. The but is the give-away in her answer.
